messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not take apixaban if you are allergic to it or if you have active bleeding from any cause.
Apixaban can cause a serious blood clot if you undergo a procedure such as a spinal tap or receive spinal anesthesia (epidural). This type of blood clot could cause permanent or long-term paralysis.
Apixaban can make it easier for you to bleed, even from a minor injury. Call your doctor if you have any bleeding that will not stop.
Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had:
- artificial heart valve;
- a history of problems with your spine, a spinal surgery, or difficult or repeated spinal taps;
- bleeding problems;
- plan for surgery, or a medical or a dental procedure;
- a thin tube (catheter) placed in your back to give you certain medicine;
- antiphospholipid syndrome, an immune system disorder that increases the risk of blood clots; or
- liver or kidney disease.
It is not known if apixaban will harm an unborn baby. Taking apixaban during pregnancy may cause bleeding in the mother or the unborn baby. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
Do not breastfeed while taking apixaban.
Triplet: ["Apixaban", "has pregnancy warning", "unknown effect on unborn baby"]

The relation 'has pregnancy warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may pose a risk to the mother or unborn baby as specified by the object entity, and patients should consult a doctor if pregnant or planning pregnancy.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
